FN-ZS44RR-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 291
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Economic Development
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/10/2023
Senate Bill 291 as introduced removes computer programs and software applications purchased
by certain State and Local Agencies from the competitive bidding process. This bill could
increase or decrease the purchase prices of computer programs and software applications
procured by these entities, depending on the difference (1) in the cost of products procured
under the provisions of this bill and (2) the cost otherwise obtained under current law.
Page 1

FN-ZS44RR-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 291
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/30/2023
Senate Bill 291 as passed the Senate would exempt computer programs, software applications,
and certain services to aid in the prevention and detection of criminal activity purchased by
certain state and local agencies from the competitive bidding process. This bill could increase or
decrease the purchase prices of such goods or services procured by these entities, depending on
the difference (1) in the cost of products procured under the provisions of this bill and (2) the
cost otherwise obtained under current law.
Page 1

FN-ZS44RR-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 291
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/31/2023
Senate Bill 291 as reported by the Committee on State Government would exempt computer
programs, software applications, manuscripts, books, maps, pamphlets, periodicals, various
databases and certain services to aid in the prevention and detection of criminal activity
purchased by certain state and local agencies from the requirement to be procured through the
Office of the Chief Procurement Officer and from the competitive bidding process. This bill
could increase or decrease the purchase prices of such goods or services procured by these
entities, depending on the difference (1) in the cost of products procured under the provisions of
this bill and (2) the cost otherwise obtained under current law.
